scope: Cumulative public-apparition inference, source dependence and shared expectations

institutions: London School of Economics, Department of International Development
University of California, Berkeley, Department of Physics

sources.title: Sensitivity to Evidential Dependencies in Judgments Under Uncertainty
sources.institution: School of Psychology, University of New South Wales Sydney
sources.status: Read primary abstract and introduction/model sections
supports: Independent firsthand observations differ from sequential testimony combining own observations with others' statements
Controlled experiments demonstrate a real evidential-dependence issue worth tracing
does_not_establish: A retrospective perceptual diagnosis for either apparition
A dependence correction factor for historical crowds

sources.title: The Virgin of Zeitoun
sources.author: Cynthia Nelson
sources.institution: American University in Cairo; author note also identifies a year at UC Berkeley Institute of International Studies
sources.status: Read opening primary text and visually checked printedp6; complete original recovered by Zeitoun audit agent
supports: Concrete cases of perceptual ambiguity and expectation, including crowd self-correction
Independent acknowledgement of surrounding streetlights disconnected fordays
Author did not identify the light source
does_not_establish: A complete ordinary explanation of the full multi-night record
That detailed observations on other nights were false

bottom_line: Some within-record dependence and shared interpretive context are demonstrated; a blanket claim that the two events are one dependent chain is not. The combined argument survives the dependence caveat, while the magnitude of the update needs explicit source and rival-hypothesis judgments.
